answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 60 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The zenith schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the jade checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An attacker wanting 10 effective identities must lock that capital for 60 epochs and keep it locked through every harbor audit. That is 39 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
